lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p13 - Listen and point.

details: Listen and point checks understanding of word meaning and sound as students match what they hear to the right image. It also strengthens first-sound awareness by isolating the target sounds before giving examples of words beginning with those sounds.
Look for careful listening, correct pointing to the target words as they are heard.

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

details: Listen and say models correct pronunciation, and gives students an opportunity to practise saying the target sounds and saying words that begin with the target sounds.
Look for careful listening, clear pronunciation and correct stress when repeating the target sounds and words.

lessonPlan.topic: Activity Book p61 - Point and say.

details: Point and Say checks letter-sound recognition.Point shows they match the sound to the right target word in the picture. Say provides a further opportunity for students to practise the saying the target sounds.
Look for correct pointing at the pictures which match the target sounds, clear sounds, and confident repetition.

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
This activity strengthens the identification of the first sounds of words, reinforces sound-letter recognition, and reinforces comprehension of the sounds by linking them to the pictures.
Look for correct sound-letter recognition and circling of the words that begin with the specified letters, and correct identification of the pictures of the circled words.

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p13 - Draw the lines to match.

details: Draw the lines to match further strengthens first-sound awareness. It demonstrates early phonics control by linking each sound to the picture that begins with it. It also helps students improve their fine motor skills by drawing the lines to connect the letters and pictures.
Look for accurate identification of the letter and sound, correct identification of the pictures and correct isolation of their first sound, and neat tracing of the lines.
